sahneler.metin: Does the brain send *signals to the ear?*
cumleler: Does the brain send signals to the ear too?
The eighth nerve does not only carry information from cochlea to brain.
Fibers also run down to the cochlea from the superior olivary complex.
These are efferent fibers; the medial ones reach the outer hair cells.
In noise, this system tunes outer hair cells so signals stand out.
